description: A jQuery plugin named Readmore.js that provides functionality to truncate and expand content sections with 'Read More' and 'Close' links, including CSS embedding, toggle animations, and resize handling.

classes.name: Readmore
classes.description: Main class implementing the readmore functionality, including initialization, toggle, resize, and destroy methods.

methods.name: Readmore
methods.description: Constructor function initializing the plugin with element and options.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the readmore sections, sets up CSS, and event handlers.

methods.name: toggleSlider
methods.description: Handles toggling between expanded and collapsed states with animation.

methods.name: setBoxHeight
methods.description: Calculates and stores the expanded height of the content box.

methods.name: resizeBoxes
methods.description: Resizes all readmore sections on window resize.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Removes the plugin's modifications and event handlers from the element.
